context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 焼きそば/シチュー/ヘルシー/試飲/薄め/ふき/アサヒ/お中元

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今晩、本気で、絶対、焼きそば、絶対、ママ、絶対、作るからね
lines.en: Sho, I'm making yakisoba tonight — seriously, I promise.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial promise. Soft emphasis on the pledge. The tone of a mother who knows exactly what her child wants and delights in delivering it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、明日は、絶対、シチュー、絶対、食べたいな
lines.en: Mom — but I really, really want stew tomorrow instead.
lines.style: Persistent but gentle request. Small voice testing the boundary, not demanding. A child negotiating with hope that he might change her mind.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、ヘルシー、絶対、なメニュー、絶対、最近、絶対、好むのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your father's been into healthier menus lately, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful aside, slightly amused at the observation. Speaking to Sho as though sharing an adult secret. Gentle, knowing tone about her husband's tastes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お祖父ちゃんが、絶対、お酒の、絶対、試飲、絶対、会、絶対、行ってきたって
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa went to a sake-tasting event!
lines.style: Bright excitement tumbling out. Quick pace, animated. The delight of a child discovering something he can't wait to share with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日のお茶、本気で、絶対、薄め、絶対、に、絶対、ママ、絶対、淹れたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I made your tea a little lighter today, the way you like it.
lines.style: Practical care, matter-of-fact. No fuss, no announcement — the quiet confidence of someone who knows her child's preferences by heart.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、ふき、絶対、の煮物、絶対、美味しかったよ、ママ
lines.en: Grandma's butterbur stew was really delicious!
lines.style: Warm nostalgia and genuine appreciation. Small voice full of contentment. A child savoring the memory of something good.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、アサヒ、絶対、ビール、絶対、好きなのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad really loves Asahi beer, doesn't he.
lines.style: Light, conversational observation. Speaking to Sho with gentle humor about his father's tastes. Almost to herself, but including him in the thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お中元、絶対、お祖母ちゃんから、絶対、届いたよ
lines.en: Mom, the mid-year gift from Grandma arrived!
lines.style: Bright announcement, quick and eager. A child bringing news he knows will be welcome. Energy barely contained, excited to share the arrival.
